title: Autism Assistant gold evaluation record
description: One human-labeled evaluation record. Model-generated labels are forbidden in this file: origin must be 'human' and labeler_id must identify a human labeler.

gold_id.description: Stable evaluation-set identifier, independent of dataset row order.

source_idx.description: Original MentalChat16K record id (idx) from the export file.

labeler_id.description: Human labeler identifier (initials or registered id).

origin.description: Must be 'human'. Model-generated labels are invalid here.

round.description: Labeling round: 1 = independent, 2 = revision after seeing the other labeler's label.

final_label.description: Final label after revision/adjudication. UNSURE records are excluded from per-category metrics but retained.

adjudicated.description: True when a third reviewer resolved a round-2 disagreement.

confidence.description: Labeler's own ordinal certainty — an ordinal self-report, NOT a calibrated probability.

notes.description: Optional free-text note; must not include other reviewers' identities beyond what labelers consent to.

gold_set_version.description: Version of the gold set this record belongs to (matches the file suffix).
